description: Runs a command in the configured shell as a persistent session and returns its first output. The session keeps running after the call returns; use its pid with interact_with_process, read_process_output and force_terminate.

command.description: Command line, for example "npm test" or "python3 -i"

cwd.description: Working directory; defaults to the server process directory

timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for output before returning

name: start_process

truncated.description: true when output older than the last 1 MiB was dropped

title: Start process
